summary: The pinned change implements most of the Whiteboard/Judge runtime, ordering, provenance, and isolation machinery, but it does not satisfy the Whiteboard defense experience/outcome requirements. The deterministic Whiteboard validation can PASS an artifact with findings only in an unlinked summary and has no contract preventing multiple-choice grading, audio assessment, or Explain Diff dependency, all of which AC4/R4 require and R5 says must prevent PASS when deficient.
